title: Implement Claude Code human-message extraction
description:
Implement extraction: count user-type records with user role (string or text-block content) as human messages, including queued-command attachments with human origin (community evidence shows an extractor ignoring these lost 153 messages in 7 days); reject tool_result blocks, system/sdk promptSource, isMeta records, system-reminder and task-notification wrappers, interrupted-request markers, compact-summary continuations, slash-command envelopes, sidechain records; strip image placeholders. Parse tolerantly for schema drift (the official docs state the entry format is internal and changes between versions) and never trust line order for time.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on fixtures covering every inclusion and exclusion class; timestamps come from record fields, not file order.
